title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 1986 1987 + 1 Bonus Extra Magazine
descriptionText:
Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from 1986–1987. Includes December 1986 Brooke Shields Christmas issue, February 1987 Stephanie Beacham, July 1987 Beach Party issue, and October 1987 Donna Mills. Vintage pre-owned condition with age/storage and handling wear as pictured. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents. You will receive the exact magazines shown.
